cardBackDescription.zh: 静谧星夜中的龙脊雪山，是冒险家们难以征服的险境，至高的目标……
cardBackDescription.en: Silent Dragonspine under the starry night is one of the highest goals and most dangerous places for an adventurer to conquer.

cardBackDescription.zh: 破晓之时的龙脊雪山，如同冒险家生涯的冠冕，作为牌手的象征之物时，则代表着「顶峰」级的实力……
cardBackDescription.en: The splendor of Dragonspine at daybreak, as the symbol of a duelist, symbolizes the "summit" of their skill...

cardBackDescription.zh: 坚铁之色的矿体，是农具与兵器的底色。层岩巨渊蕴藏的诸多矿产，仍是令人敬畏的巨大财富……
cardBackDescription.en: An iron-colored mineral that forms the base of farm tools and weapons alike. With its abundant mineral reservers, who knows what untold riches The Chasm still holds...

cardBackDescription.zh: 靛青之色的矿体，是冒险之路向远方延展的信号。层岩巨渊蕴藏的诸多矿产，仍是令人敬畏的巨大财富……
cardBackDescription.en: An indigo-colored mineral that signals the way forward, telling you that more adventures lie ahead. With its abundant mineral reservers, who knows what untold riches The Chasm still holds...

cardBackDescription.zh: 黄金代表最为辉煌的财富，无论冒险家、矿工还是牌手，都将这色彩视为事业的冠冕……
cardBackDescription.en: Gold, the most glorious form that wealth can take. Whether you're an adventurer, miner, or card player, it represents the crowning achievement of your career...

cardBackDescription.zh: 常夜的帷幕中，蛰伏着诡谲的危祸。牌手的前路上，或许也深隐着未知的险阻……
cardBackDescription.en: Devious dangers lie in wait in the shroud of evernight. Hidden perils yet to be unveiled lurk in the path of duelists...

cardBackDescription.zh: 大日御舆的辉光，是渊下宫内最为炽目之物。破除深隐的险阻后，牌手亦如海渊之下的强光，无论面临何种困局，都将寻获前路……
cardBackDescription.en: The radiance of the Dainichi Mikoshi is the most dazzling sight within Enkanomiya. After overcoming hidden perials, duelists, like a brilliant light beneath the ocean's depths, will find their path forward, no matter the obstacles they face...

cardBackDescription.zh: 夜色中的大赤沙海，静谧而空旷的黑暗中，四处隐伏着危机。但正因如此，此时的大赤沙海也是向往变强之人的绝佳试炼场……
日落至入夜之间的大赤沙海，间或呈现出深沉的金属之色。沙漠本身也如锻锤的铁砧，不断磨砺着穿行其中的人们……
炽烈阳光映照之下，大赤沙海中流淌的晶莹沙粒宛如散落的黄金。深埋其间的秘宝，更令无数冒险家心驰神往……
